utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks for the update—I can probably swing by Saturday and help sort donations. What time should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Saturday afternoon works best — I’d say come by then and we can sort the donations as people arrive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, Saturday afternoon it is—I’ll come by then and help sort donations as people arrive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll bring work gloves and a screwdriver set if I can find mine.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara — I’ll note the gloves and screwdriver set. Are you heading to the church basement, or somewhere else for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m planning to head to the church basement for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll bring the toolbox, flashlight, and some gloves over for you. Just tell me where to meet and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — let’s meet by my front steps. I’ll keep an eye out for you.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll head over to your front steps with the toolbox, flashlight, and gloves in a bit.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m still in, I just need to check what I can bring. Want me to spread the word to a few neighbors too?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, that’d help a lot — I’ll mention the repair drive to the others and keep things moving on my end.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, I’ll do that — I’ll ask a few neighbors and then check what I can bring too. Thanks, Vik!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m keeping an eye on the supplies, and if we’re short on anything for the repair drive, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks—can you confirm you’re actually keeping an eye on the supplies, and let me know if you’ll be there Saturday too?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — I’m keeping tabs on the supplies, and I’ll let you know right away if anything’s short. I should be there Saturday too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ve already been spreading the word, and I can pass your invite around too if you want. Just let me know what you need me to share.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great—could you tell folks I could use a shovel, a bit of gravel, and maybe someone handy to help patch the driveway?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread that around and tell folks you could use a shovel, some gravel, and a hand patching the driveway.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, just let me know what’s needed and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo — I really appreciate that. I’m still a little worried about what they need and where to leave things, so I’m waiting to hear back from Tess.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No problem — once Tess replies, just send me the details and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with that — who’s picking up supplies and where are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet on who’s picking up supplies or the exact meeting spot — can you check those details for me?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check on the pickup and meeting spot, and I’ll let you know as soon as I have the details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — we still need a few tool donations, some volunteer sign-up names, and a couple of spare tarps. If you can help round up any of those, that would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can try to round up a few tool donations and see if anyone has spare tarps. If you still need sign-up names, I can ask around too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Rey — thank you. If you can ask around for sign-up names too, I’ll keep the list updated as responses come in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll swing by and ask what they still need and where the next drop-offs should go. Then I’ll let you know so we don’t leave anything in the wrong spot.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess — that would really help. I appreciate you keeping me in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: No problem at all — I’ll check in and pass along whatever they say. Better to get it right than leave things piled up where they don’t belong.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What’s still missing for the repair drive, and who’s handling it? If there’s anything practical left, I can help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Mina. Gus is bringing the toolbox and a flashlight, and I’ll check what else we need after that.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—let me know after that check, and I can take on whatever practical piece is left.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—just send me the quick details and timing, and I’ll help with the drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Bo — could you drop the kits off at the church basement by 3 if you can? I’ll make sure they’re ready from the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, 3 at the church basement works for me. I’ll swing by the community shed first and drop them off after.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Kira — I’ve already been spreading the word, and I can pass your invite around too. If you’re coming, I’d love a hand with work gloves or a screwdriver set if you have one.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, are you saying you’ll be there on Saturday too? I can bring a screwdriver set.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes — I’ll be there on Saturday too. Thanks, and bringing the screwdriver set would be a big help!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like it’s going well so far—I’m still planning to swing by later and see what needs doing. If you’ve got a shovel or any gravel to spare, that’d really help with the driveway patch.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — I’ll ask around for a shovel and any spare gravel, and I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive. Swing by later and we’ll compare notes on what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate that. I’ll swing by later and see what still needs patching up.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. Let’s keep it simple and start with the toolbox and flashlight, then we can plan the rest.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I can help with the toolbox and flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, Rey. That’s a solid start, and we can take it one step at a time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That matches what I have too—Saturday afternoon for the neighborhood repair drive, with tools, spare parts, and small repairs. If there’s a specific time or place I should note, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday afternoon around 3:30 after pickup works for me. You can note the school parking lot as the meet-up spot, and I’ll send any final details for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — Saturday around 3:30 after pickup, meeting at the school parking lot. I’ll note that down, and I’ll watch for your final details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds promising—what still needs sorting, and is there anything I can help with on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I can help with a few items on Saturday. Just send me the quick list and timing, and I’ll do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I’ll send over the quick list and timing. Thanks — even a little help sorting donations would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can help keep things organized. Tell me the meeting spot and who’s handling supplies, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m pretty sure it’s the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday afternoon, and folks are bringing tools, spare parts, and anything small that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks — I’ll let everyone know it’s Saturday afternoon and that they should bring tools, spare parts, and small repairs. If you settle on the meeting spot or supply runners, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, it’s just a drop-off at the community shed, isn’t it? I’ll bring whatever tools and spare parts I can by Saturday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Noah — I just want to make sure the right things end up in the right place. If you hear what they still need, let me know and I’ll help coordinate it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Will do — if I hear anything, I’ll let you know. I’ll drop off what I can by Saturday afternoon at the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo — I’m keeping track of the pickup locations and meeting spot. So far, Sam has the repair kits from the community shed and will bring them to the church basement by 3.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Opal. If you need a hand with pickups or moving anything, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo — I’ve got the main pickup and meeting spot noted, but I’ll let you know if anything else needs moving.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I’d appreciate that a lot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I’ll pick up the repair kits from the community shed and bring them to the church basement by 3.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. That really helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll swing by and ask what they still need and where they want the next drop-offs. Then I’ll let you know so we don’t leave anything in the wrong spot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—please tell me exactly what they still need and where the drop-offs should go. If there’s any practical task left, I can handle it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely—I’ll ask for the exact list and the drop-off spot, then bring it back to you. If there’s a task they want done, I’ll let you know too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be a huge help, thanks. I’ll set the boxes by the garage and try to keep the tools in one pile—if I wander off, just call me back!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Oren — I’ll keep an eye on the tool pile and start asking around for the extra tarps and volunteer names.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — that really helps a lot. If you find anyone with tarps, send them my way, and I’ll keep working on the garage pile.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet—I’ll bring my toolbox, flashlight, and a pair of gloves for the repair drive. Just point me to where you need me most.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — that’s really helpful. Could you start near the back fence, and I’ll bring my gloves and screwdriver set too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll head to the back fence first and get started there. Just let me know if you need me to tackle anything specific.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
